description: Replays the 'scale-and-replay' page: burst, scale the leaderboard to three members, then rebuild Redis from the log and diff the top 10.

tests.description: A burst drains, three members split the partitions, and a replay rebuilds an identical leaderboard

runShell.command: docker compose exec -T rpk rpk group describe leaderboard
for i in $(seq 1 30); do lag=$(docker compose exec -T rpk rpk group describe leaderboard </dev/null 2>/dev/null | awk '/^TOTAL-LAG/ {print $2}'); [ "$lag" = 0 ] && break; sleep 2; done; echo lag=$lag
docker compose exec -T redis redis-cli ZREVRANGE leaderboard:global 0 9 WITHSCORES > before.txt && wc -l < before.txt
docker compose exec -T redis redis-cli FLUSHALL
docker compose exec -T rpk rpk group seek leaderboard --to start
for i in $(seq 1 60); do lag=$(docker compose exec -T rpk rpk group describe leaderboard </dev/null 2>/dev/null | awk '/^TOTAL-LAG/ {print $2}'); [ "$lag" = 0 ] && break; sleep 2; done; echo lag=$lag
docker compose exec -T redis redis-cli ZREVRANGE leaderboard:global 0 9 WITHSCORES > after.txt && wc -l < after.txt
diff before.txt after.txt && echo "leaderboard identical after replay"
